what: L7 from-scratch XGBoost moneyline-member tune: 89-trial seeded random search over ALL SIX XGBOOST_PARAMS dims (depth 1-4 x min_child_weight x gamma x subsample x colsample_bytree x learning_rate), incumbent included as same-harness reference; rounds never searched (probe constants 2000/20; each config's own budget measured from its probe bests).

harness.rank_key: tuning-window pooled refit logloss (static at the config's self-median budget); walk ll co-measured
harness.walk_regime: causal (probe measures on the fold val window; shipped fit at the median of PRIOR folds' bests; fold 0 at XGBOOST_FOLD0_ROUNDS)

screen.observation: All top-8 margins vs the incumbent are <0.001 tuning refit ll; the search's leading direction is consistently slower lr (0.03) + stronger shrinkage (col ~0.45-0.55, mcw/gamma at the strong end), with depth scattered across 1-4 - depth is not the discriminator once shrinkage is right.

confirm.note: Depth-1 trials excluded from finalist consideration per owner directive (no depth-1 stump). Three depth-eligible finalists carried to a 3-seed FULL-WALK gate vs the incumbent's 2026-09-30 3-seed full-walk baseline (walk 0.68706/0.5540, refit 0.68662/0.5562).

t50_d3_mcw24_g8_lr0.03_col0.55.verdict: Tuning-window lead REVERSED on the full walk - same tune-gain-does-not-survive pattern as L6.

verdict.reason: No finalist cleared the >=0.001 member logloss gate on the 3-seed full-walk; the seal phase (folds 70-77) was therefore not reached, per protocol - sealing sub-gate challengers would mine noise. Third consecutive retune (L5 0921, L6 0928, L7 0930) in which the production config survives.
verdict.auc_note: t85/t24 tilt AUC-positive (+0.001..+0.003 member) while logloss-neutral; noted, not actionable under the logloss-first member gate.

context.prior_tunes: L5 2026-09-21 (adopted), L6 2026-09-28 (confirmed), 2026-09-30 AM depth-1->2 owner-directed adoption (seal-confirmed), L7 2026-09-30 PM (this record).

addendum_rounds_and_early_stop.trigger: Owner directive 2026-09-30: no parameter stays off the table from prior tests. The FOLD0/REFIT_ROUNDS 50-vs-20 seal had run at depth 1 only (pre-adoption), and XGBOOST_EARLY_STOP had never been varied.

A_refit_budget_at_deployed_depth2.design: static refit, full 78 folds, 3 seeds, budgets 20/30/50/75/100
A_refit_budget_at_deployed_depth2.gate: @30 beats shipped @50 by -0.00127 mean (3/3 seeds) - above the 0.001 member gate on the full walk
A_refit_budget_at_deployed_depth2.seal_gate: @50 beats @30 by -0.00184 mean (3/3 the other way) on the untouched window
A_refit_budget_at_deployed_depth2.verdict: SPLIT VERDICT across windows -> window-dependent noise, not a budget effect. UNCHANGED at 50 per the LGBM rounds precedent (tune-gain must survive the seal). Overcooking is real: @75/@100 degrade monotonically.

B_early_stop_screen.design: probe patience {10, 20, 40} at the deployed block; causal walk + own-median refit, tuning folds 0-69, seed 42
B_early_stop_screen.verdict: es=20 confirmed: clearly better than 10, statistically tied with 40 (refit ll -0.00012, below gate). The shipped patience stands.

addendum_rounds_and_early_stop.leakage_note: EARLY_STOP is testable in the causal pipeline: the early-stopped probe is measurement-only, the shipped fold model never sees its own val window, and the round budget ships from PRIOR folds' medians. The instrument was nonetheless kept fixed during the main search and scrutinized only in this addendum, so the search never selected its own measurement noise.
